_comment: Single source of truth for every Higgsfield request. hfgate.py builds prompts ONLY from this file + a segment spec. Do not paste prompt text by hand.
project: 2026 제11회 구로 청소년축제 오프닝 · 종이비행기 원테이크

plane_sheet.what: 종이비행기 마스터 시트 (무지 흰 A4 다트형)

classroom_back.what: 교실 A: 뒤에서 본 정면(칠판), 창문=왼쪽 벽

corridor.what: 복도 C: 창문=오른쪽, 교실문+사물함=왼쪽, 바닥 빛 줄무늬

field_low.what: 운동장 F: 지면 로우앵글, 학교 건물 배경

seq1_start_frame.what: SEQ1 시작 키프레임 (창가 책상 위 비대칭 다트 비행기, 기수=앞-오른쪽 문)

location_refs._rule: A location that is VISIBLE anywhere in a segment (even through a door or window) must have its reference attached (lint L2).

locks.STYLE: ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT from the first frame to the last frame: a single take with no cuts, no edits, no jump. Smooth steady gimbal camera moving continuously, photorealistic live action, natural colours, 16:9.
locks.PLANE: The same single plain white dart paper airplane as in the airplane reference sheet (blank white A4 paper, no print, no logo). It is clearly asymmetric: narrow sharp pointed nose at the front, wide straight squared-off tail at the back. It always flies NOSE FIRST on one continuous flight path: it never jumps, never teleports, never flips, never reverses, and only changes direction through slow gentle curves. Its size and shape never change.
locks.LIGHT: Sunny late morning, the same warm sunlight direction throughout, soft dust in the sunbeams, no flicker.
locks.classroom: The classroom matches the classroom reference: ivory walls, green chalkboard on the front wall, rows of light-wood desks with grey metal legs, large aluminium windows with white roller blinds along the LEFT wall, wood-grain floor, open sliding door at the FRONT-RIGHT corner leading to the corridor.
locks.corridor: The corridor matches the corridor reference photo exactly, both when glimpsed through the classroom door and when the airplane flies in it: glossy light-grey floor with bright sunlight stripes, tall aluminium windows on the window side facing the sports field, ivory wall with sliding classroom doors and blue-grey metal lockers on the classroom side, square LED ceiling panels.
locks.field: The sports field matches the field reference photos: light-brown compacted dirt field with white lines, white soccer goals, green trees around it, the ivory three-storey school building, clear blue sky.
locks.sky: Clear deep blue sky with a few soft clouds above the same school field.

negatives_global: no airplane flying backwards or tail first
no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos

forbidden_positive_terms._rule: Words that must NOT appear in the positive (non-negative) part of a prompt — each comes from a user decision. Use 'allow_terms' in a spec to override with a reason.

terms.hand: D3 SEQ1: 손으로 날리지 않음 (바람으로 이륙)
terms.cheer: D4 SEQ3 S4: 환호 금지, 바라보며 웃기
terms.whistle: D5 SEQ3 S2: 호루라기 소리 금지
terms.pointing at: D4 (사람이 손가락질 금지; 'nose pointing toward'는 허용)

SEQ2.title: 복도, 빛의 줄무늬
SEQ2.note: field is seen through the corridor windows and at the exit; classroom is behind the camera
